configuration.muon_charges: mu- chemical potential +mu_mu; mu+ chemical potential -mu_mu; both summed

paper_reference.B13: Full moving-muon 2->2 collision integral with Fermi blocking and Bose occupation.
paper_reference.B14_B16: Spin-summed vector-current nonrelativistic/no-recoil approximation. The factor (1+m_V^2/(2 omega^2)) is retained or dropped as two separate comparisons; the 1/v_V in B.16 cancels the v_V in B.14.
paper_reference.citation: N. Blinov et al., arXiv:2511.09619v2, JHEP 06 (2026) 155

scope_limits: Local source-rate comparison only; no radial integration or escape probability.
B.14-B.16 is compared only to the pure-vector B.13 rate.
No B.14 vector formula is assigned to the axial or UV mixed-current rates.
No coupling, production, absorption, opacity, or profile rescaling is performed.
The full pure-vector Fig. 7 validation gate remains separate and is not passed by this local comparison.
title: B.13 exact moving-muon vs B.14-B.16 no-recoil semi-Compton comparison
